Lipschitz Regularity in Some Geometric Problems
ABDELGHANI ZEGHIB
CNRS, UMPA, E´cole Normale Supe´rieure de Lyon, 46, alle´e d’Italie, 69364 Lyon cedex 07,
France. e-mail: Zeghib@umpa.ens-lyon.fr
(Received: 23 August 2002; accepted in ﬁnal form: 7 April 2003)
Abstract.The Lipschitz regularity is perhaps the most natural, and surely the most geometri-
cal among all the types of regularities. For example, the Lipschitz character of an ordinary
differential equation (vector ﬁeld) is the natural classical sufﬁcient condition for the (unique)
integrability of this equation. The goal here is to show that, in some sense, the Lipschitz regu-
larity is also necessary, if one assumes (geometric) individual conditions on the trajectories. In
